```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
imdb_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  response <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(seconds = 120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform()

  page_table <- resp_body_html(response) |>
    html_element("table")
  imdb_table <- html_table(page_table, header = FALSE)
  rating_tooltips <- html_elements(page_table, "strong[title]") |>
    html_attr("title")

  if (length(rating_tooltips) != nrow(imdb_table) - 1) {
    stop("The number of rating tooltips does not match the table rows.")
  }

  snapshot <- imdb_table |>
    slice(-1) |>
    transmute(
      rank_and_title = str_squish(X2),
      rating = parse_number(X3),
      tooltip = rating_tooltips
    ) |>
    extract(
      rank_and_title,
      into = c("rank", "title", "year"),
      regex = "^(\\d+)\\.\\s+(.+)\\s+\\((\\d{4})\\)$",
      convert = TRUE
    ) |>
    mutate(
      snap_year = snapshot_year,
      number = parse_number(
        str_match(tooltip, regex("based on ([0-9,]+) votes", ignore_case = TRUE))[, 2]
      )
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)

  if (nrow(snapshot) != 250 || anyNA(snapshot)) {
    stop("The scraped snapshot did not produce 250 complete rows.")
  }

  snapshot
}

imdb_2015 <- tryCatch(
  fetch_imdb_snapshot(imdb_urls[1], snapshot_years[1]),
  error = \(e) {
    message(
      "Could not scrape the 2015 Wayback capture: ",
      conditionMessage(e),
      ". Continuing with the saved dataset."
    )
    NULL
  }
)

if (!is.null(imdb_2015)) {
  print(imdb_2015)
}
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- readRDS("data/imdb_snapshots.rds")
print(imdb_snapshots)
print(count(imdb_snapshots, snap_year))
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year == 2015) |>
  select(title, year, rank_2015 = rank) |>
  inner_join(
    imdb_snapshots |>
      filter(snap_year == 2022) |>
      select(title, year, rank_2022 = rank),
    by = c("title", "year")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    release_decade = year - year %% 10,
    rank_change = abs(rank_2022 - rank_2015)
  )

top_ten_rank_changes <- rank_changes |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(top_ten_rank_changes)

average_rank_change_by_decade <- rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarise(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade)

print(average_rank_change_by_decade)
```

```{r}
film_snapshot_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  group_by(title, year) |>
  summarise(snapshot_count = n_distinct(snap_year), .groups = "drop")

snapshot_count_distribution <- film_snapshot_counts |>
  count(snapshot_count)

print(snapshot_count_distribution)
```
